body:
Your three bugs are fixed on branch worktree-cl12 (main merged in, 8 of 8 suites pass). Main can fast-forward to it; I did not push main (this session may push only its branch). Your installed board shows the fixes after its next kit update.

## Text off screen (root cause, fixed once)
A flex or grid child keeps min-width:auto, so a long word or name pushes it out of its box. Each earlier fix was per component. Now one base rule covers every element, present and future. Your comment headers had their own cause: a popup-title rule (`h2 {flex:none}`) hit every ## in the orchestrator's comments. A train's name ran off the left (box wider than its scroll area). The "New below" pill floated outside the orchestrator panel on a desktop.
The guard: `kit/board/test_page_layout.js` (now in run_all_tests) fails when any text line runs off screen or is cut, at phone and desktop widths. Pictures: `docs/assets/cl12/before-02-phone-discussion.png` and `docs/assets/cl12/after-02-phone-discussion.png`.

## The badge that never cleared
A reply to the thread of your Like was hung under the Like, which is never drawn: never on screen, never seen. Your board has 2 such replies (22:01, 22:19). They now show under what you liked, and every unseen reply unfolds.

## Done steps missing from the train view
The tasklist matched posts' train ("cli") against the group's display name, so only open steps matched. It now keys by train id.

## Also
Your sent / seen / answered marks each have their own word. A translated board wrote removals to a translated "posts/" path (fixed).

title: Board UI: text never runs off screen, badge clears when seen, Done steps stay in the train view
verdict: Fixed all three: text overflow at the base layer with a browser check that fails on any cut text, the badge (hidden replies to a Like), and Done steps in the train view.
